verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5070 Ti is a discrete graphics card, so a training-data opt-out (a policy or control that keeps a vendor from training models on user data) is a category error for this kind of product. The marketing line that local AI runs 'fully private' on an RTX PC describes on-device inference. It does not describe a documented control that stops user data from being used for training, so it does not make this axis apply.
